notes_for_us: The whole request is furniture - machines in rows and tables with chairs - and there is no option anywhere for a cluster of themed props. The catalogue covers cover, hazards, spawns and triggers, all of which are gameplay furniture, and has nothing for the decorative kind, which is what a place prompt is usually made of.

No genre was clearly right and the file says so, but the Explorable Place preset then supplied three of my four IDs, so a prompt that named two things came back with a landmark, a circulation grain and a screenshot spot. Preset padding shows up harder on no-genre than on any real genre because there is no genre signal to argue against it.

Not actually playable is a load-bearing instruction with nowhere to live. I put it in mechanics, where it will be read by the stream that builds behaviour, but the image and placement streams are the ones that need to know these props are inert.
